Method of Attack: Encrypts files by killing processes and services that lock files (e.g., WordPad, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Thunderbird, SQL, VirtualBox)
Aborts encryption on systems from blacklisted countries
Targets corporate victims by terminating key software processes
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running WordPad, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Thunderbird email clients, SQL servers, VirtualBox virtual machines
